root_cause.text: An inverted conditional check in the `ccu_mix_trigger_fc()` function of the SpacemiT CCU driver caused the frequency update logic to be skipped whenever the frequency control register was valid, preventing proper clock scaling.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff modifies `drivers/clk/spacemit/ccu_mix.c` line 76, changing the condition from `if (common->reg_fc)` to `if (!common->reg_fc)`, which corrects the logic to return early only when the register pointer is null.

intent_record.what: Inverted the boolean condition checking common->reg_fc from positive to negative.
intent_record.how: Ensures the ccu_update call is reached when the register is valid, fixing logic that previously skipped the update on supported hardware.

vuln_statements.explanation: Based on the vulnerability root cause, this conditional check in ccu_mix_trigger_fc() contains an inverted logic that causes the frequency update to be skipped when the FC (frequency change) bit is set. The correct behavior should be to proceed with the update when FC_BIT is present, not return early.
